scope: Post hoc CPU audit of completed fixed-A195, V195/V198, X+12cm window experiments. Every physical outcome is reported; only the preregistered early-low pair tests the primary. RMS is a saved-array distance, not function, language/motor anatomy, object information, probability or success percentage. Decoder block net updates combine attention and MLP residual additions and BF16 rounding. A hard mask also redistributes remaining attention. Current/action boundaries are available, future hidden boundaries and full QKV are not. No new model, solver, physics, training or general target/identity/root-cause experiment.
